query.title: Business/company name or registration number
query.description: A business/company name (or partial name), or an exact BCCAR registration number (e.g. 000013082). All-digit input is searched as a registration number; anything else is searched as a name.

queries.title: Names or registration numbers
queries.description: Multiple names/registration numbers to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

certNumbers.title: Certificate numbers
certNumbers.description: Optional: exact certificate numbers to search by. Only certificates issued via the Online Business Registry System (after 28 Nov 2022) are matched -- BCCAR's own limitation, not this actor's.

entityType.title: Filter by entity type
entityType.description: Optional: restrict results to one entity type. Combine with 'query'/'queries' to filter a name search, or leave name/registration-number fields empty to list every entity of this type.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max matches per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return per search job.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search jobs to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Off by default -- no anti-bot protection (WAF/CAPTCHA/TLS fingerprint gate) was found on this target's public search API during recon, so a direct connection works reliably. Turn on if you run a very high query volume.
